answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller identity to lock 100 jade tokens before taking one job at a time. The contract holds the bond until settlement and forfeits it if the seller misses an on-chain delivery deadline. Creating mirror identities cannot reuse that collateral: each extra active identity adds the same stake delta. An attacker running 1,000 identities must lock 100,000 tokens, and missed deadlines burn the corresponding bonds.
